title: Dolly Parton: Photos From an Extraordinary Life and Career
text:

 Dolly Parton and her collaborator Porter Wagoner perform onstage, circa 1967.

 Ron Hill / The Oklahoman / USA Today Network / Reuters

 Dolly Parton and the Wagon Masters pick and sing for a Civic Center Music Hall audience in Oklahoma City on October 8, 1968.

 Dolly Parton sings for Johnny Carson on The Tonight Show on December 14, 1977.

 Lily Tomlin, Dolly Parton, and Jane Fonda, in costume on the set of the 1980 movie 9 to 5 .

 Dolly Parton sits in on a performance at Dollywood in 1987.

 Getty

 Dolly Parton meets young schoolchildren at the Magna Science and Adventure Park on December 5, 2007, in Rotherham, South Yorkshire, England. Parton chose the former steelworks town to be the first European location to participate in her “Imagination Library” literacy scheme. The charitable program, which she launched in her hometown of Sevierville, Tennessee, in 1996, encourages young children to discover the joys of reading, by sending every participating preschool-age child a free book every month.

 Bebeto Matthews / AP

 From left: Patricia Resnick, Dolly Parton, Robert Greenblatt, Megan Hilty, Allison Janney, and Stephanie Block react during a press conference for the new musical 9 to 5 in New York, on July 15, 2008.
